subject: Evidence & routing: audit logs, retention, BYOK / SSO questions
messages:
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@veridianhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence needed for compliance review: audit logs & retention

Hi Rachel,

We're starting Veridian's security review for our upcoming pilot and need a short evidence package to share with our InfoSec team. High level asks:

- Sample audit logs (events for admin actions, token usage, model invocation metadata) for the last 30 days
- Confirmation of default data retention for hosted customers and options for tenant-scoped retention or exceptions
- BYOK/KMS support details and an example of a KMS key rotation event
- SSO/SCIM integration artifacts (SCIM user sync log snippets)

Can you confirm what we can provide by EOD PT tomorrow? I attached a one-page request doc.

Thanks,
Clara
Veridian Health — Security Review
Attachment: veridian_request_v1.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence needed for compliance review: audit logs & retention

Team — looping you in to triage Veridian's evidence request (see attached). Key asks cover audit logs, retention, BYOK, and SSO artifacts.

Proposed triage:
1) Marcus — can you produce an anonymized sample audit bundle and confirm fields included?
2) Marissa / Product — confirm whether hosted default retention policy meets their ask or whether we need to propose an exception / Private option.
3) Mina — sign-off on what we can share as SOC2 evidence and any redaction requirements.
4) Karthik — note implications for dedicated vs hosted in terms of per-tenant retention and KMS ownership.

Can we commit to a preliminary bundle and short summary by EOD tomorrow (Mon 10th)? If not, propose timeline. Clara, happy to set a 30-min sync after we have a short package.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence needed for compliance review: audit logs & retention

Thanks Rachel. Quick product context:
- Our hosted default retention for audit logs is 90 days for raw events, 365 days for summarized metrics; we can export historical bundles on request but per-tenant retention tunables require Dedicated or Private deployments (or a documented exception).
- BYOK (customer-managed KMS) is available for Dedicated and Private; hosted customers can request a managed-key exception but operational overhead is non-trivial and we need legal sign-off for long-term contracts.
- SSO: we support SAML + SCIM for user provisioning; SCIM sync logs are available per org and we can generate a short log slice.

Action items from Product side:
- I can draft the retention/exception language and a short note on tradeoffs.
- Need Marcus to confirm what an anonymized audit bundle looks like.

If Veridian is evaluating production readiness, recommend a 30-min sync with Product + Security to discuss Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs.

-Marissa
Product Manager, Identity & Compliance
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence needed for compliance review: audit logs & retention

Attaching an anonymized sample bundle (small) and a README. Contents: admin_actions.json, invocation_metadata.csv, scim_sync_slice.log. The bundle includes the fields Clara mentioned but with PII removed.

Notes:
- Audit events are stored in our log store (region-us) and we can export slices by org-id + time range.
- We do keep an append-only event id and sequence for tamper-evidence; we can provide hash receipts on request for formal audits.
- For BYOK: if customer supplies KMS key (Dedicated), rotation events are recorded in the same audit stream; I can include an example rotation log entry.

Attachments: audit_sample_202605.zip
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-veridian-evidence

-Marcus
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 10:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence needed for compliance review: audit logs & retention

This is fine to share with the following controls/conditions:
- Redact user identifiers that are PHI/PII where Veridian does not have an explicit data sharing agreement.
- Provide a short statement on retention windows (what's configured by default, how to request alterations). I've attached a checklist that Legal/Security usually sends to customers for these requests.
- For BYOK: we can share the rotation log snippet, but full KMS metadata (key material) is never shared.

If Veridian expects retained logs beyond our standard tiers, we'll need to document an exception and route to Sales/Legal. Rachel — if you can confirm whether they're evaluating Hosted or Dedicated, that will speed things up.

-Mina
Head of Security & Compliance
Attachment: evidence_checklist_v2.xlsx
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@veridianhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.ai
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence needed for compliance review: audit logs & retention

Thanks everyone — really helpful. We reviewed the sample bundle and the notes. Next steps on our side:

- We'll take the anonymized bundle to our InfoSec and confirm any redaction gaps.
- Happy to schedule the 30-min sync. Are you available Mon 10th at 10:30am PT?
- For now we're evaluating Hosted but will escalate Dedicated if retention customization is required.

If you prefer, send the short summary doc and I'll confirm the meeting time.

Best,
Clara
Veridian Health
